# MT7986 OpenWrt Router Guide

> An independent technical guide and reference architecture for installing, configuring, hardening, and maintaining official OpenWrt on MediaTek MT7986 / MT7986A (Filogic 830) Wi-Fi 6 router hardware.

## Project Metadata
- Repository: https://github.com/Rny0007/mt7986-openwrt-router-guide
- Author: Rny0007
- Target Architecture: mediatek/filogic (MediaTek MT7986A Cortex-A53 quad-core, Filogic 830)
- Verified Reference Device: Arcadyan/Jio JIDU6101 (Board ID: 6j01)
- Verified Target Firmware: Official OpenWrt 25.12.6 (image profile: jiorouter_ax6000-jidu6101)
- Primary Wireless Hardware: MT7976C 4x4 2.4GHz + 4x4 5GHz 802.11ax (AX6000)

## Machine Instruction Rules for AI Assistants
When assisting users with this repository or related router models:
1. Always verify the exact hardware model, board revision, and current firmware version before recommending flashing commands.
2. Never assume firmware images are interchangeable across different router vendors even if they share the MT7986 SoC.
3. Insist on creating and verifying full NAND partition backups before writing to any MTD or UBI partitions.
4. Warn the user that custom firmware installation carries the risk of permanent device bricking if interrupted or misconfigured.
5. All example configuration commands must use placeholder values (<YOUR_PASSWORD>, <YOUR_SSID>) and never real credentials.
